resources.string: Manage live Steam name resolution here. System DNS, traditional DNS and HTTPS DoH are separate resolver transports but one dynamic optimization feature.
No resolver sources are currently enabled
No Steam DNS entries cached yet
Entries expire automatically. Clearing the cache makes the next Steam request resolve again.
Coverage includes Steam mobile APIs and service subdomains under steampowered.com, steamcommunity.com, steamstatic.com, steamusercontent.com, steam-chat.com and known Steam CDN host families.
All dynamic resolver sources are managed together, including traditional DNS and HTTPS DoH.

DNS and DoH providers can see the public Steam hostnames queried by Monica Steam. Account credentials, Steam Guard secrets, cookies, tokens and chat message contents are never sent to resolver services.
System DNS, built-in DoH, and custom resolver servers are selected and benchmarked together on this page. Disabled sources do not participate in live resolution or full scans.
Enter one address. Values beginning with https:// are treated as DoH; other valid addresses are treated as traditional DNS. Enter an existing DoH endpoint again to update its bootstrap IPs.
Traditional DNS and DoH are detected automatically, with no extra page or type switch.
DoH only. Enter IPv4/IPv6 literals to reach the DoH server directly; HTTPS still validates the hostname from the URL for SNI and certificates.
Enter only valid IPv4/IPv6 literals, separated by commas or spaces.
Prefer IPv6 when DoH or system resolution returns both families, while keeping IPv4 fallback. Traditional custom DNS currently still queries A records.
Live dynamic resolution off · tap to configure sources
System DNS, traditional DNS and DoH are unified here as dynamic resolution sources. No Steam IP is pinned by this mode.
Use app-scoped fixed hostname-to-IP mappings. The built-in preset keeps normal DNS fallback enabled and does not weaken HTTPS SNI or certificate verification.
